root_cause.description: The download handler accepts an arbitrary request-selected filename before the file open.

fix.description: Permit the declared public file and deny other request-selected names before os.ReadFile.

decisions.rationale: The direct call and argument path supports a candidate; a live HTTP request and fixed behavior require separate execution evidence.

unresolved.claim: A loopback HTTP request through the registered route must read the private fixture file.
The same request must be denied after the allowlist while public and constant-notice controls still work.
